## Relationships

### [Opal Pettigrew](../character/opal-pettigrew.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/herb-tranter--opal-pettigrew.md)

Herb Tranter became romantically involved with [Opal Pettigrew](../character/opal-pettigrew.md) during Volume 3. Their relationship ended when Opal, who suffered from consumption, passed away peacefully after confessing her fear of dying.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Life P0](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0000), [v3 ch.Life P6](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0006), [v3 ch.Life P8](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0008), +6 more_
